Two sets of identical twins—masters and their servants—are reunited in Ephesus after years of separation following a shipwreck. The brothers from Syracuse unknowingly enter a city at war with their homeland, risking execution. Mistaken identities spiral into accusations of theft, infidelity, madness, and possession as citizens confuse one twin for another.
